login.title: Cable installation
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage Progressliste and Gesamtliste.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.dbUntil: The current database covers Progressliste through {date}. Upload a new Progressliste on the Upload page to refresh.
dashboard.summary: Of {total} total cable length, fully pulled cables are currently {fully} and partially pulled length is {partial}, totaling {pulled}. Not started yet: {notStarted}.
dashboard.anschlussTitle: Wired but not handed over (no verlegt) — {count} cables. Click a row for the route.
dashboard.anschlussNotStarted: At least one side wired — pull not started yet
dashboard.anschlussStart: Start wired (Anschluss 1) — start point not handed over
dashboard.anschlussEnd: End wired (Anschluss 2) — end point not handed over
dashboard.anschlussBoth: Start and end wired — no verlegt date
dashboard.leaveMissingTitle: {count, plural, one {# person has not submitted leave} other {# people have not submitted leave}}
dashboard.leaveMissingHint: No leave day is marked in the headcount Excel from today onwards.
dashboard.empty: No data loaded. Upload Progressliste and Gesamtliste on the Upload page.
dashboard.searchHint: Multiple cable IDs: semicolon or new line. Comma is part of the ID (e.g. 2114,1).
dashboard.searchRequired: Enter a cable number (use semicolon or new lines for several).
dashboard.filterNoteHelp: Shown at the bottom of the PDF. If empty, the searched cable IDs are used.

devices.title: Device list
devices.subtitle: {count} devices total
devices.help: Type a device / cabinet name — the list filters live. A cable matches if either end (A or E) goes there. Click status counts to filter. Click a cable to expand the route with the pulled segment highlighted.
devices.filterStarted: started, but not yet at the device
devices.started: {count} cables started but not yet at the device
devices.clickHint: Click a cable for the route.
devices.priorityHelp: Wired = Anschluss on that side. Pulled = pull reached the device end (A/E). Click a row for the detail list. Export: statuses and columns like Supports / lanes.
devices.prioritySortHint: Sorted by most cables first. Orange bar = pulled to device, teal bar = wired (vs total).
devices.exportColsHelp: Which fields should go into the Excel?

nearComplete.title: Near-complete cables
nearComplete.subtitle: Started but not fully pulled cables where remaining length is at or below the threshold. Click a row for the route.
nearComplete.fullyPulledAfter: Fully pulled total after: {after} m (now {now} m · +{gain} m)
nearComplete.fullyPulledAfterLive: Live Progressliste fully pulled after: {after} m (now {now} m · +{gain} m)
nearComplete.fullyPulledGainHint: If you finish these near-complete cables, each one adds its full Length_m to the fully pulled total (not just the leftover meters).
nearComplete.fullyPulledGainHintLive: Handing over the filtered list would grow the live Progressliste fully pulled total by this amount (current verlegt + full Length_m of remaining rows).
nearComplete.clickHint: Click a cable for the route.
nearComplete.liveUploadHint: Upload a fresh Progressliste — only verlegt (handed-over) cables are used for filtering.
nearComplete.excludeLive: Hide handed over in live list
nearComplete.excludeLiveHelp: When checked, hides cables that have a verlegt date in the live Progressliste.
nearComplete.liveFilterWarn: Upload a live Progressliste first to use this filter.

filterPage.title: Filter
filterPage.subtitle: Stützen/Bahn, device, status, thickness, category and stop in one place — with Kurzliste and pull-card export.
filterPage.needFilter: Set at least one filter (nodes, device, status, thickness, category, or stop).

stutzen.title: Supports / lanes filter
stutzen.help1: Enter support and lane numbers separated by semicolons.
stutzen.help2: AND keeps cables whose route contains every value. OR keeps cables whose route contains any value.
stutzen.exportColsHelp: Which fields should go into the Excel?
stutzen.areasDefault: Built-in room data (until a newer upload).
stutzen.areaInsertHint: {label}: {bahn} lanes · {stuetzen} supports — mode switches to OR after insert.
stutzen.noBahnStuetze: No lane / support data for this room.
stutzen.clickHint: · Click a cable for the route.
stutzen.filterNoteHelp: Printed at the bottom of the PDF. Leave empty to use the current Supports / lanes filter.

areas.title: Areas
areas.subtitle: Drag rooms into priority (max {max}/room from the puller pool). Click a row for details. Without an upload, built-in room data is used.
areas.overviewHint: Orange bar = remaining work weight (person-hours vs heaviest room). Teal strip = pull % within that.

workforce.title: Workforce
workforce.subtitle: Daily headcount and productivity vs pulled meters.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.subtitle: Everyone by category, with shift and project settings.

teams.subtitle: Create tasks, assign a group lead and workers.
teams.needUpload: Upload the workforce Excel on the Workforce page first.
teams.leadHint: Gold = group lead. Pick the lead from the task select; one lead can cover several tasks.
teams.poolEmpty: No unassigned people for this filter.
teams.noTasks: Create a task with the field above.
teams.clickTaskHint: Click the lead / workers slot to place the selected person
teams.howToStart: Task name + size → Task. Then drop a lead and workers onto the column.
teams.poolHint: Drag onto the task lead / workers slot, or click: person → slot.
teams.stepAddTask: Enter the task name and size, then Task.
teams.stepAssignLead: Drop a group lead into the lead slot.
teams.stepAssignWorkers: Drop cable pullers / electricians into workers.

categories.autoHint: From the Excel position. Pick another to override.
categories.manualHint: Set by hand. The empty row restores the automatic guess.

workers.noAccess: No access. Only planners and admins can see worker profiles.
workers.notFound: No worker found with this name: {name}
workers.markInactiveHint: Hidden from Organisation and Tasks lists. You can undo this anytime.

progress.title: Progress
progress.subtitle: Top figures are current state (same as Dashboard). Charts are daily/weekly events: Gestoppt = partial, verlegt day = remaining complete.
progress.dailyChart: Daily pull — orange = partial, teal = complete

calculator.title: Calculator
calculator.subtitle: Pick a cable — route, status and already-pulled segment appear. Enter only the segment you just pulled. If you reached an end, the icon next to start/end inserts the A/E node (requested allowance is included automatically).
calculator.needPoints: Enter start and end points to calculate.

stichmass.title: E-Stichmaß
stichmass.subtitle: Support → A-end (Knoten_A) segment length + Aln_A. Multiple cables at once.
stichmass.resultMeta: Support: {stuetze} · {ok}/{total} ok · Click a row for Support→A segment.

upload.title: Upload
upload.subtitle: To refresh Progressliste, a new Progressliste is enough if Gesamtliste is already uploaded. First time both files are required.
upload.needGesamt: Gesamtliste is also required for the first upload.
upload.gesamtHint: Leave empty to keep the previous Gesamtliste

guide.title: Guide
guide.intro: Upload Progressliste and Gesamtliste on the Upload page. Filters run server-side. Exports stay on the API (CaTra / Kurzliste).
guide.deploy: Deploy: Docker Compose on Hetzner — see deploy/HETZNER.md
guide.auth: Auth: email/password with roles admin / planner / worker
